title: Promote landed core work and distill the free, lean, fast release candidate
goal: Record the open-core boundary, preserve commercial functionality in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps, and compose the closed functional Susi core contributions from the v0.21.54 base into a release candidate without force-moving shared history.
limitations: The candidate remains unqualified until the exact release tree passes the full Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 release gates; source publication is not production qualification.
